remarks: Situated on a peaceful 0.64 acre lot on a desirable cul-de-sac in the heart of Darien, this beautifully renovated 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath home offers an exceptional blend of modern style and classic elegance. The thoughtfully designed open floor plan features a newly updated eat-in kitchen with high-end appliances, perfect for culinary enthusiasts and family gatherings. The formal living room provides a welcoming space for guests, while the sun-filled family room with French doors open to a professionally landscaped backyard.  The first-floor guest suite offers privacy and convenience, ideal for visitors. A generous mudroom includes ample cabinets and storage for everyone. Upstairs, the primary bedroom suite serves as a private retreat with a newly updated spa-like bathroom, featuring luxurious finishes with his and hers closets. An additional two bedrooms with an updated bathroom complete the upper level. The lower level features a cozy bonus room with fireplace, gym and renovated full bath. An additional highlight is the office space which opens directly onto a beautiful stone patio, offering a serene space for work. This home is conveniently located just minutes from town, train station, schools, parks and amenities. Whether you're looking for privacy, elegance, or convenience, this home delivers it all in a perfect setting.
